source: correlated assistant message textContent/raw text only

frame.outside_frame_text: ignored for semantic parsing but preserved in RAW; any second response frame is ambiguity failure

interior_modes.accept_if: trim(frame interior) parses as exactly one JSON object

frame interior contains exactly one fenced code block whose textContent parses as exactly one JSON object; surrounding prose is ignored only if it contains no second fenced block or additional parseable JSON object

reject_if: more than one parseable JSON object
canonical_output: parsed JSON object only; wrapper prose/fences never enter CANONICAL representation
raw_output: full correlated assistant text is retained unchanged for audit
